title: Exercise 3: Multiply Binomials and Combine Like Terms
exerciseInfo: Practice multiplying two binomials by distributing each term, simplifying the numerical products, and combining like terms.
Arithmetic Level 2 is allowed. This permits nested sums and products, the negative unit, and simple nonnegative whole-number exponents.
Use Change Form to rewrite the repeated product x times x as x squared, then factor the common x from 5x + 6x before evaluating 5 + 6.
completionMessage: The binomial product has been expanded and all like terms have been combined.
